description.narrative: The project will help the Government of the Philippines boost local government revenue mobilization to improve local public service delivery and strengthen local governance. The focus will be on improvements to the administration of the real property tax (RPT) and on management reforms.

Output: Institutional development and policy support for property valuation strengthened Indicator: Property valuation function in BLGF established and operational with 30 core staff Achievement: N Progress/Status: Bureau Order No. 159.2025 issued for the implementation of the RPVARA including the establishment and operationalization of the RPVs. As a result of the Forum conducted by the HROD Expert on September 29, 2025, and the subsequent meetings with the BLGF Central and Regional Directors on organizational development for the creation of the RPVS, the consultant has submitted the Organizational Assessment Report on Structure, Functions, and Processes for review and approval of the Bureau as of the last week of December 2025. Output: Real property taxation of selected LGUs enhanced Indicator: Tax compliance review and tax efficiency studies with gender perspective conducted in at least 50% of participating LGUs Progress/Status: The Real Property Tax Compliance and Impact Study Report has been completed for 18 out of 20 pilot LGUs, with the remaining 2 reports currently awaiting official LGU endorsement. Output: Institutional development and policy support for property valuation strengthened Indicator: Policies, rules, and regulations for RPT reforms drafted Progress/Status: Local Assessment Manual (LAM). Training on the Enhanced LAM was conducted on 10-14 November 2025. The Publication of Department Circular No. 004.2025, or the Local Assessment Manual dated 5 November 2025, in a newspaper of General Circulation is scheduled in January 2026 while printing is targeted for completion in Q1 2026.
Philippine Valuation Standards (PVS), 3rd Edition. Department Order No. 022.2025 dated 15 October 2025, was published in a newspaper of General Circulation on 15 December 2025, while printing is targeted for completion in Q1 2026.
Mass Appraisal Guidebook (MAG), 2nd Edition. Publication in a newspaper of general circulation will proceed once the Department Circular for the MAG is signed by the Secretary of Finance, with due consideration of the transition to the new SOF and printing is scheduled in Q1 2026.
Assessment Evaluation Examination and Monitoring Manual (AEEMM). Currently being finalized for submission to the Management in December 2025 and the printing is scheduled in Q1 2026
Real Property Tax Compliance and Impact Study (RPTCIS) Guidebook. The finalized version of the draft Guidebook is for submission to the management for approval and the printing is scheduled in Q1 2026.
Guidelines on the submission of SMVs. MC No. 022.2025 on Submission of Proposed Schedule of Market Values (SMVs) prescribing the process of review and endorsement of the proposed SMV signed by the Executive Director on 2 December 2025 was submitted by BLGF Central Office to BLGF Regional Office Regional Directors on 18 December 2025.
Data Source: Copies of RPT policies and instruments (e.g. manuals and procedures) issued Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not drafted Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not drafted Target year: 2026 Target value: drafted

Output: Real property taxation of selected LGUs enhanced Indicator: Property general revision conducted and assessment records updated in at least 50% of participating cities Progress/Status: 16 out of 20 LGUs or 75% have approved SMVs, exceeding the overall project target of 10 LGUs. 1 LGU with pending publication since their SMVs were approved after the enactment of the RPVARA. The SMVs of the remaining 3 LGUs will be updated through the RPVARA process wherein the SMV will be reviewed by the BLGF for approval of the Secretary of Finance.
Continued technical assistance from the Bureau has led to strong progress in the General Revision (GR), 11 out of 20 or 55% LGUs have successfully completed their General Revision (GR), while One (1) LGU has partially completed General Revision. One (1) LGU has suspended the conduct of its General Revision, and 3 LGUs have not yet undertaken the General Revision. Meanwhile, the remaining 4 LGUs are currently undergoing SMV formulation under the RPVARA process. Data Source: Review of SMV database, review of integrated tax assessment system portal Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not applicable Baseline year: 2017 Baseline value: not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: 50%
